title: peer_fetch.rs: SizeExceeded detection uses fragile string matching on internal error
description: fetch_with_https_client (and its test-only twin fetch_peer_blob_from_url) detect size-limit exceeded via msg.contains("length limit") — a string match on the Display output of http_body_util::Limited's internal error type. This is fragile: any change to the upstream error message silently breaks the detection, causing SizeExceeded to be reported as a Network error instead. Additionally, the full size-limit/hash-verify/store-write logic is duplicated between fetch_with_https_client and fetch_peer_blob_from_url (~40 lines each). Fix: match on the error type rather than its Display string, and collapse the duplication.
